preconditions.description: The length of the input string must be between 1 and 100 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(33 <= ord(c) <= 126 for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: Each character in the input string must have an ASCII code between 33 and 126, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be the input string with its characters in reverse order.
